bossBattle.taunt: I want to impress my granddaughter|by winning this battle.
I want to show my granddaughter|I am not too old to win.
I am so proud on my grand parents.|They are the best!

I personally teached Mei Lian|some skills in battle
The Earth Elite is a really strong guy!
I will show you which Elite is the best!
You just made me look bad.|We need a rematch!
Defeat me and I will give|you the Legendary Kitine
I want to be just as strong as the Fire Elite!
Did the Fire Elite see my cool moves?
Let me show to Blaze one more|time how a fire battle is done.
Defeat me and I will give|you the Legendary Kobalt
Maybe some day I could become|the Electric elite?
What? Cable thinks he could|be an Elite hahah!
Defeat me and I will give|you the Legendary Eelonyx
Give me another chance to|proof I could become an Elite!

Defeat me and I will give|you the Legendary Evren

content.text: Welcome to the Tall Pines!
Did you come here to become|a Dynamon Captain?
Let's start by testing your SKILLS!
NICE! you have great potential.|Now choose your own Dynamon!
Great choice, you will make a great team!
Now, I have something to give you...
These ITEMS will be useful in your journey.
Speaking of which,|let's find a WILD DYNAMON...
Let's find some wild|Dynamons to BATTLE!
WAIT! Now that it's weak, let's|try to CATCH it!
WOW! Your Dynamon can LEVEL UP!
We use SHARDS to do that.|Use some now!
You can SWITCH Dynamons during battle.
Let's use the Hermatude you just caught!
That's Sofia, she is a trainer like you...
Go and BATTLE her!
During battles, you can use one ITEM per turn.
Use the SKILL CAN you just got!
Dynamons and Skills have TYPES...
Use the STRONG type when possible!
WOW, you're STRONG!|But I'm stronger!
Next time i won't lose!
You got access to a new location.
Let's go there!
Hi! My name is Julian...
Let's practice our battle technique!
Maybe I'm too old for this...
Great adventure ahead, | stay safe, my dear.
There is a strange scientist living in | this forest somewhere.
I heard he is making a robot Dynamon.
Did Remi say there is a robot Dynamon?
Do you think it will be more powerful | than a normal Dynamon?
A scientist? You mean that weird guy | over there in the distance?
Looks like he is performing some kind of test.
Ah you look like a person who | can help me out with a test right?
I created the first robot Dynamon called Beebot!
I want to compare the skills of my Beebot | robot against my other electric dynamons.
I am a genius! Beebot's first tests | in battle are successful!
You can keep this Beebot. Could you | test it some more for me in battle?
For some reason the Beebot can't evolve yet. | Give me some time to figure it out.
Let us meet again later for a new test!
Wow you got a robot Dynamon? | I want to see it!
Could you show me the Beebot Dynamon in battle?
That was amazing! I also want to | have a robot Dynamon!
Do you think the scientist | could also build a robot for me?
My name is Jeff from the construction company.
You name it! I build it!
Let me know if I can be of any assistance.
I always dreamed of living in a treehouse.
Maybe I could ask Jeff to build me a treehouse?
The scientist is waving at you! | I think you need to go to him.
So what do you think about the Beebot?
I have figured out the problem | why he could not evolve yet!
Select your Beebot in your team | and I will fix the glitch in his software.
